angle_en: Mamashritya: refuge in the person himself
angle_hi: मामाश्रित्य: स्वयं व्यक्ति में ही आश्रय

en.intro: Krishna names the deepest human fear to show the path beyond it. Listen for the one who takes refuge in him.
en.notice: Those who take refuge in Krishna to escape old age and death come to know Brahman, self, and action.
en.next: Krishna then tells how those who know him at the moment of death see the whole world differently.
en.meaning: Those who, seeking release from old age and death, take refuge in me, come to know Brahman, the whole field of the inner life, and all action.

hi.intro: कृष्ण सबसे बड़े मानवीय डर का नाम लेते हैं ताकि उससे आगे का रास्ता दिखा सकें। सुनिए, जो उनका आश्रय लेता है।
hi.meaning: जो जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति, वे ब्रह्म, सम्पूर्ण अध्यात्म और सम्पूर्ण कर्म को भी जान जाते हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर बताते हैं कि जो मृत्यु के समय भी उन्हें जानते हैं, वे इस संसार को कैसे देखते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna names the deepest human fear to show the path beyond it. Listen for the one who takes refuge in him.
en.body: Those who, seeking release from old age and death, take refuge in me, come to know Brahman, the whole field of the inner life, and all action. Those who take refuge in Krishna to escape old age and death come to know Brahman, self, and action. Krishna then tells how those who know him at the moment of death see the whole world differently.

issues: wrong_fact: "Listen to the word mamah, me, and mamashritya, having taken refuge." (The Sanskrit word 'माम्' (mam) means 'me' (accusative of 'I'). The Hindi word 'मामह' (mamah) is a genitive form meaning 'of me'. The script incorrectly identifies 'मामह' as 'me'. This is a factual error in the Sanskrit terminology.)

borrowed: "Listen to mamashritya, having taken refuge, and mamah, the genitive form of I. The refuge is not a place, but the person of Krishna himself, who promises to free those who strive for release from old age and death." (The notice presents the meaning of the NEXT verse (verse 30), which states 'Those who know me together with the physical realm, the radiant powers, and the inner sacrifice know me even at the time of death', as if it were part of this verse's content.)
